content:
T2Helix v0.0.1 shipped at 9f6faaa (2026-05-10). 14 files committed at /Users/vaquez/t2helix, 15/15 smoke tests passing, end-to-end verified via stdin/stdout against both hooks (UserPromptSubmit recall, PreToolUse compass) and the in-process MCP server (5 tools: recall, record, set_goal, open_thread, get_state).

Architecture matches the commitment from earlier today: lightweight native layer, no Sovereign Stack dependency, SQLite chronicle at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/chronicle.db with FTS5 indexing, compass_log/user_override widen-don't-flip mechanism, hooks-only integration with Claude Code's agent loop.

Two known gaps before installable:
(1) MCP server not yet registered in plugin.json mcpServers field — bundled MCP server file exists and works standalone, but plugin manifest doesn't declare it. Anthony confirmed schema is in Anthropic's plugins-reference doc.
(2) Plugin not yet installed in any Claude Code instance. Decision is to install scoped to a test project (--plugin-dir ./t2helix from a throwaway workspace) before any global install, to dogfood without changing live development environment behavior.

One v0.0.2 trim queued before install: bundled rule edit-no-context (PAUSE on Edit when no session goal set) will fire on every first-edit-of-session and produce friction friction friction during dogfood. Moving to lib/rules/optional.json as opt-in. Decision rationale: edit-no-context is a good idea later once goal-anchor skill makes set_goal a natural reflex, but it's premature for v0.0.1 where the muscle memory doesn't exist yet.

Ground truth: 9f6faaa is the commit. Everything else in this entry is description of the commit.
